# Da3wat Farah | دعوة فرح

> Da3wat Farah is the leading Arabic wedding invitation platform, allowing users to create, customize, and share stunning electronic wedding invitations online. The platform supports Arabic and English languages.

## Basic Information

- **Name**: Da3wat Farah (دعوة فرح)
- **URL**: [https://da3watfarah.com](https://da3watfarah.com)
- **Type**: SaaS Platform - Electronic Wedding Invitations
- **Languages**: Arabic (default, RTL), English
- **Target Markets**: Egypt, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, and the wider Arab world
- **Technology Stack**: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Cloudflare Workers, Firebase Realtime Database, Cloudflare R2 Storage

## What Da3wat Farah Does

Da3wat Farah enables couples to create professional, digital wedding invitations in minutes. Users can:

1. **Choose from 24+ Templates**: Including Classic Golden, Modern Elegant, Romantic Soft, Islamic Luxury, Bohemian Free, Royal Luxury, Artistic Love, Elite Wedding, Floral Dream, Minimal Chic, Nature Love, and Starry Night.
2. **AI Text Generation**: Generate professional invitation text using NVIDIA-powered AI.
3. **Customization**: Full color customization, photo galleries, custom music, Google Maps integration, countdown timers, and QR codes.
4. **RSVP System**: Track guest attendance confirmations.
5. **Share Instantly**: Share via WhatsApp, social media, QR code, or direct link.
6. **Three Occasion Types**: Engagement (خطوبة), Katb Ketab (كتب الكتاب), and Wedding (فرح).

## VIP Exclusive Templates (17+ Designs)

Da3wat Farah offers a dedicated VIP tier at [https://da3watfarah.com/vip/](https://da3watfarah.com/vip/) with premium, video-enhanced invitation templates not available in the standard plans. Categories: Wedding (فرح), Engagement (خطوبة), Henna Night (حناء), Ramadan/Eid greetings, Birthday (عيد ميلاد), Newborn announcements (مولود جديد), and Graduation (تخرج). Each VIP template features a cinematic opening video, luxury animations, and interactive countdown/RSVP sections. VIP is a lifetime one-time subscription (400 EGP / 500 SAR / $25) that unlocks all 17+ exclusive designs plus everything in the Premium plan.

## Pricing Plans (Lifetime, One-time Payment)

1. **Free**: Preview templates only, 1 basic template, 10 photos, no publishing.
2. **Premium (150 SAR / 150 EGP / $10)**: All 24+ templates, unlimited photos, custom link, all features, AI writing, QR code.
3. **VIP (500 SAR / 400 EGP / $25)**: Everything in Premium plus custom domain, logo removal, unlimited songs, advanced AI, priority 24/7 support, unlimited edits.

## Key Features

- **24+ Premium Templates**: Designed by Arab designers for Arabic weddings
- **AI Text Generation**: Powered by NVIDIA for professional invitation copywriting
- **Interactive Photo Gallery**: Upload and display photos with elegant effects
- **Custom Music**: Add favorite songs or background music
- **Google Maps Integration**: Interactive venue map for guests
- **QR Code**: Unique QR code for each invitation
- **Countdown Timer**: Live countdown to the wedding day
- **RSVP System**: Track guest confirmations efficiently
- **Multi-currency Support**: SAR, EGP, USD with automatic country detection
- **PWA Support**: Installable as a mobile app
- **Responsive Design**: Works perfectly on all devices
- **Cloudflare R2 Storage**: Fast media delivery worldwide
- **Firebase Realtime Database**: Real-time guest interactions

## Occasion Types

- **خطوبة (Engagement)**: Engagement party invitations with dedicated AI text templates
- **كتب الكتاب (Katb Ketab)**: Islamic marriage contract ceremony invitations
- **فرح (Wedding)**: Wedding day invitations with full feature set

## API Endpoints (Cloudflare Worker)

- `POST /api/ai/generate` - AI text generation for invitations (NVIDIA API)
- `POST /api/upload` - Upload images/songs to R2 storage
- `GET /files/:key` - Serve uploaded files from R2
- `POST /api/verify-payment` - Payment verification
- Firebase Realtime Database for real-time data
